entities.name: UniProt:P37748
observations: Exact sequence match to the 388-aa query; reviewed UniProt annotation identifies it as putative O-antigen polymerase.
Annotation: may polymerize O-antigen repeat units on the periplasmic face of the inner membrane; probable. K-12 strains generally lack O-antigen production in vivo due to rfb-cluster mutations.
Annotated as a multipass inner-membrane protein; sequence-derived mass 44.74 kDa, pI 9.05, GRAVY 0.853.
